newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-VILLA'S BOSNICH SET FOR FIRST TEAM COMEBACK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VILLA'S BOSNICH SET FOR FIRST TEAM COMEBACK.

text.p: Aston Villa's Australian goalkeeper Mark Bosnich, sidelined since the start of the season with damaged knee ligaments, could be back in the side to face Tottenham in the premier league on October 12.
Bosnich trained with Villa's goalkeeping coach Paul Barron on Wednesday. He is expected to play a reserve team match on October 9.
"He has had to take things slowly and not rush back," Villa manager Brian Little said. "One of his targets is the Spurs game but he is hoping to play in the reserves before then."
